data.raw_text:
LOOK: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) leads the launch of the second leg of the “Yes to Ayos” campaign with Lola Daisy Plina mascot at Pateros Elementary School on Thursday, May 21.

The initiative promotes discipline and responsible behavior in public spaces across Metro Manila, in line with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s directive to strengthen programs fostering a culture of discipline.

During the event, the MMDA introduced the “Yes to Ayos” codes, encouraging proper use of pedestrian crossings, adherence to traffic rules, responsible waste disposal, and orderly queuing in trains and escalators, among others. | 📸: Niño Jesus Orbeta, Philippine Daily Inquirer
